sentences.text: Court No. - 10

Case :- Criminal Misc. Writ Petition No. - 3035 of 2023
Petitioner :- Sugreem @ Sugreev Thru.

Father Bhrignath
Respondent :- State Of U.P. Thru.
The Secy. Deptt. Of Home Lko.
And Others
Counsel for Petitioner :- Sanjay Kumar

Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.
Hon'ble Mrs. Sangeeta Chandra,J.
Hon'ble Narendra Kumar Johari,J.

Heard Shri Sanjay Kumar, learned counsel for the petitioner, Shri Pracheesh Pandey, learned A.G.A.
for the State-respondents No.1 to 3 and perused the record.
For the order proposed to be passed, this Court does not feel it appropriate to issue notice to respondent No.4.
Hence, notice to respondent No.4 is dispensed with.

The present writ petition has been filed by the petitioner with the prayer to issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of Certiorari for quashing the F.I.R. dated 008.04.2023, registered as F.I.R./Case Crime No.175 of 2023, under Sections 452, 376 (3) I.P.C. and Section 3/4 of POCSO Act,
at Police Station - Motipur, District - Bahraich registered against the petitioner, as contained in Annexure No.1 to the writ petition.

A further prayer has been made for issuing a writ, order or direction in the nature of Mandamus commanding and directing the respondent Nos. 2 and 3 not to arrest the petitioner on the basis impugned FIR.
Sugreem @ Sugreev
Thru .
Father ... vs State Of U.P. Thru.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The Secy. Deptt. Of ... on 20 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/92629906/
1 Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that out of the enmity on political grounds the impugned F.I.R. has been lodged.
On the other hand, learned A.G.A. states that the victim/opposite party No.4 has given her statement under Section 161 and 164 Cr.P.C. supporting the prosecution story.

This Court has perused the impugned F.I.R. and finds that the impugned F.I.R. discloses commission of cognizable offence against the petitioner, hence, no interference is called for by this Court in its extraordinary power under Article 226 of the Constitution of India for quashing of the F.I.R. or for grant of any interim relief to the petitioner.
The petition lacks merit and is, accordingly, dismissed.

Order Date :- 20.4.2023 ML/-
